current.text: Yahoo lists him as questionable with an ankle injury.
He re-signed with the Knicks for 2 years and 9 million USD.
He is a projected Knicks starter next to Brunson, Bridges, Anunoby and Towns.
Experts expect his minutes to stay near 30 per game. They see little chance of a return to 34 to 37 minute nights because the Knicks will be careful with his workload, so he has little upside.
Experts name him the Knicks starter most at risk of decline. They point to wear and tear and a long Finals run, and say he already showed signs of decline.
He played through hand injuries last season.
One expert does not believe his three-point shooting near 41% will hold.

Experts disagree a little on price. The Knicks preview calls an ADP around 100 about right for a late pick. Josh would only draft him if he falls to about 120 and would pay no more than 2 USD in an auction. Another speaker avoids him completely.
Experts call earlier ADPs of 61 to 83 far too high.
His block rate fell last season. One analyst thinks it could move back up.
The Knicks won the championship. They are projected to win about 50 to 54 games.
The Knicks play a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs.
The Knicks have a weak fantasy playoff schedule for a season that ends March 28.

durable.text: He is a stat stuffer. He gives good rebounds and assists for his position, average steals, and a good FG% on low volume.
His 9-cat value looks better than his real worth.
Over his career he has been a 31 to 33 percent three-point shooter.
His game relies on motor and athleticism.
He has a badly damaged finger. He has said that surgery on it would end his career.

note: Hart is a cheap filler for any build. He helps in rebounds, assists, steals and FG% without a weak category, but the experts say his 9-cat rank (Yahoo 98, ESPN 97) overstates him and he has little upside at about 30 minutes. Do not pay more than the market cost of 2 to 3 USD, well below the 6 USD our league paid last season, and the Knicks' weak schedule for our March 28 playoff end lowers him further. Early on, check his ankle (Yahoo Q), whether his minutes stay near 30 and whether his three-point shooting drops back toward his career 31 to 33 percent.
